calibration.noData: No data yet: enable the plugin with /jev-on, run a session, then return to calibrate
calibration.overApprovalBasis: {v0} over-approval risks (Jev would approve, human rejected) / {v1} agreement samples
calibration.tightenPreapproval: Raise the auto-approval threshold ({v0}) to reduce over-approvals, at the cost of more human confirmations. A risk signal warrants advice at ≥{v1} samples; tightening never expands permissions.
calibration.preapprovalUpperBound: preapproveAutoApproveMin has reached the suggested upper bound {v0}. Over-approval signals persist: narrow preapproveToolAllowlist or disable preapproveEnabled.
calibration.overApprovalSamples: {v0} over-approval signals, but only {v1} agreement samples (< {v2}); continue observing
calibration.frictionBasis: No over-approvals; humans approved all {v0} referred calls ({v1}% of approved calls)
calibration.relaxPreapproval: Lower the auto-approval threshold ({v0}) to reduce extra confirmations, provided there are no over-approvals. Revert immediately if an over-approval signal reappears.
calibration.preapprovalLowerBound: preapproveAutoApproveMin has reached the suggested lower bound {v0}. If friction persists, inspect the preapproval assessment rather than lowering it further.
calibration.frictionSamples: friction (Jev requests review, human approves): {v0} cases, but fewer than {v1} samples or below {v2}%; no relaxation suggested yet
calibration.preapprovalDegraded: All {v0} preapproval records fell back (usually answer-shape-mismatch). Jev responses remain unparseable, so preapproval is ineffective. Check provider/response format first (/jev-log detail), then allowlist configuration.
calibration.preapprovalNoSamples: No preapproval samples: an empty preapproveToolAllowlist produces no auto-approval assessments or agreement buckets
calibration.denyBasis: {v0}/{v1} deny decisions (>{v2}%); the block rate is high
calibration.raiseDeny: Raise the hard-block threshold ({v0}) to send more high-risk calls to human review. Some irreversible calls will lose a hard-block safeguard.
calibration.denyUpperBound: guardDenyConfidence has reached the suggested upper bound {v0}. If deny remains excessive, inspect excludeTools/readOnlyTools coverage or guardEnable.
calibration.replayBasis: No deny decisions; all {v0} high-risk samples went to human review. Replaying a lower threshold would produce {v1} deny decisions (within the ≤{v2}% cap).
calibration.lowerDeny: Lower the hard-block threshold ({v0}) to block clear high-risk irreversible calls and reduce approval fatigue. Human review remains the fallback for other high-risk calls.
calibration.denyLowerBound: {v0} has reached the suggested lower bound {v1}. High-risk samples still produce no deny decisions; review reliance on human confirmation or the tools' risk profile.
calibration.replayNoChange: No deny decisions and {v0} high-risk samples, but lowering the threshold in replay still produces no deny decisions or exceeds the {v1}% cap. Keep current settings.
calibration.highRiskSamples: No deny decisions and only {v0} high-risk samples (<5). Tools may be low-risk, or excludeTools/readOnlyTools coverage may be too broad; inspect coverage first.
calibration.mediumRiskBasis: {v0}/{v1} ask decisions (>{v2}%); medium-risk escalations account for more than half ({v3})
calibration.raiseConfidence: Raise the confidence threshold for medium-risk escalation ({v0}) to reduce human reviews. Medium-risk calls with lower confidence will pass directly.
calibration.confidenceUpperBound: guardConfidenceMin has reached the suggested upper bound {v0}. If medium-risk escalation remains excessive, consider extending readOnlyTools or reviewing the tasks' inherent risk.
calibration.irreversibleBasis: {v0}/{v1} ask decisions (>{v2}%); low-risk irreversible calls account for more than half ({v3})
calibration.raiseCeiling: Raise the irreversibility escalation ceiling ({v0}) to tolerate a higher probability of irreversibility. Some actually irreversible low-risk calls will no longer be escalated.
calibration.ceilingUpperBound: guardIrreversibleCeiling has reached the suggested upper bound {v0}. If escalation persists, check whether the tools are inherently irreversible.
calibration.injectionDominant: {v0}/{v1} ask decisions is high; suspected injection causes more than half ({v2}). Injection safeguards are observation-only for calibration; current thresholds remain effective.
calibration.mixedTriggers: {v0}/{v1} ask decisions is high, with mixed triggers (medium risk {v2}, low-risk irreversible {v3}, high risk {v4}, injection {v5}); no branch accounts for more than half.
calibration.allDelegated: All {v0} samples are delegate decisions. The risk gate may be ineffective: the session may be low-risk, or readOnlyTools/excludeTools coverage too broad. Inspect before deciding.
calibration.injectionObservation: {v0} suspected-injection escalations in this window. Injection safeguards receive observations only and are never relaxed; current values remain effective.
calibration.guardSamples: Only {v0} guard samples (< {v1}); insufficient data for risk-gate advice
calibration.mixedModes: This window mixes shadow ({v0}) and enforce ({v1}) records. Calls auto-approved in enforce mode do not enter agreement buckets; collect another shadow window before changing thresholds.
calibration.legacyRecords: This window contains legacy records without scores (detail parsing fallback, precision 0.01)

msg.cmdStatsDesc: Show Jev decision stats (last 200 by default; --all for everything)

  shadow  = record decisions only, do not act
  enforce = act on decisions (deny/ask/auto-approve)
